(05)
3 min

Sure

or maybe?

Is the speaker sure or not sure?

be (not) going to + verb → we are sure.
What’s the weather going to be like? · It’s going to be dry this afternoon.

might (not) + verb → it’s possible, but we aren’t sure.
They said it might rain. · It might not be a good day for the beach.

No to after might: I might to go → I might go.

We don’t usually use might in questions: Might it rain? → Is it going to rain?
